$comment: Hardware Qwen3-TTS needs to run locally. Below the minimum, only Kokoro (~0.5 GB) runs locally and Qwen voices use fal. Read by scripts/reelmakeeasy.mjs (setup, doctor) and local_tts.py (serve). Apple Silicon shares RAM between CPU and GPU; NVIDIA needs both GPU memory and system RAM. Below the recommended RAM, the server keeps one Qwen model loaded at a time.
$asrComment: Speech to text for caption timing (stt.py): Whisper and a forced aligner, ~2.15 GB on mlx, ~2 GB on cuda, ~0.9 GB on cpu. An NVIDIA GPU under minVramGB runs the cpu models instead (mps always does). Below minRamGB, speech to text stays off and captions are timed in the cloud.
$toleranceComment: Machines report a little less than their nominal size (a 32 GB PC shows ~31.8 GB), so checks allow this much slack.
